items.title: Claude Code 2.1.302 released
items.text: Added CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode · Added an Idle compaction row to /config for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off · Added a notice to /design-sync and /design-login that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026 · Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted
